acceptanceCriteria: A proposed AMAP spec amendment (human acceptance required) defines DI-constant resolution, the fail-closed cases and the name_from anchors.

After acceptance: implementation with focused and hostile fixtures (single registration resolves; duplicate, non-literal and unprovable tables stay non-literal-name), sealed change evidence; GitHub #685 closed by the merged PR.
body: GitHub beamfall/corvint#685, follow-up to #669 (V1-0981, AMAP-V0-016) on main-ecfff8e. On an adopter AngularJS admin app, appmap build still reports 153 of 176 states non-literal-name: the state-name table reaches the router function as an injected parameter (const Routes = ($stateProvider, StateConstants) => $stateProvider.state(StateConstants.X, ...)) registered with .constant('StateConstants', T), not via a static import. Ask: resolve a router-function parameter or $inject entry N through a .constant('N', T) registration in a tracked file where T is a wholly readable table (object literal, or a const/enum that file imports); fail closed (state stays non-literal-name) on multiple registrations of N for the app, a non-literal name, or an unprovable T; record the .constant line and table declaration as name_from anchors.
